name: Turkey Parmesan Meatball Bake
evidence: No catalog meatball-parmesan bake exists; the nearest turkey neighbor 'turkey-meatball-marinara-pasta' shares protein + marinara but is a pasta dinner (different starch + method), and 'turkey-meatball-sub-bake' is a bread/sub format, so this cheese-blanketed no-pasta oven bake is a distinct low-carb plate.
cross_protein_collision_watch: STRONG: the source recipe is literally a keto CHICKEN parmesan meatball recipe (sugarfreemom.com), rebuilt to turkey per the no-ground-chicken rule - a chicken 'parmesan meatball bake' or 'chicken parm meatball' candidate in the chicken pool is the SAME DISH with a different protein and should not co-ship with this.
MODERATE: any beef or pork 'meatball parmesan / marinara-and-mozzarella meatball bake' (no-pasta, cheese-blanketed) in another selector's pool is structurally this same plate.
NOTE: a classic breaded 'chicken parmesan' cutlet is NOT this dish (different form) - only the meatball-parmesan-bake variants collide.
notes: Ground-chicken -> ground-turkey rebuild; optional almond-flour + frying oil dropped for the oven-bake path. Carries unmapped ingredients (marinara/board-home, fresh parsley, Italian seasoning, basil) - not penalized per v2.1 5.1 (pricer-lane exercise). Cuisine: Italian, widens catalog low-carb Italian beyond skillet/soup formats.
